description: Import and Export Control Department - Elimination of the requirement of Import Control Licenses for Suitable Sugar
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969. It contains legal/regulatory content including the citation of the regulations, their effective date, and specific amendments to import control schedules. While it mentions Minister Basil Rajapaksa, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes - the ministerial reference is purely to establish the legal authority for the regulatory action. The core content is regulatory framework and compliance requirements for import controls.
